name: Unpacking
short_description: Unpack boxes into a new home, one move at a time, and learn a life from the things you carry.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Unpack boxes into a new home, one move at a time, and learn a life from the things you carry.

identity.core_loop: Open a box, pull out one object, find where it belongs, place it; when the box is empty the room tells you who lives here.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Tactile and calm; every object clicks and thuds with its own sound.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: No words at all: the story lives in the objects and the rooms. A soft highlight shows a thing that is in the wrong place at the end of a level.

identity.art_direction: Clean pixel-art rooms at one fixed isometric angle, every object a readable little sprite.

rendering.signature: Every object is a crisp little sprite with a soft dark outline, placed in a clean isometric room under flat even light.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Readability first: one even light and a thin outline make hundreds of small objects legible at a glance.

identity.audio_mood: Gentle acoustic music; a different foley sound for every object on every surface.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Tell a story with objects only, and give every placement its own sound. Zero words, zero fail, a clear finish when the room is done.
